Pakistan Clinch ODI Tri-Series Title with Thrilling Run Chase Against Sri Lanka

Pakistan Secure Tri-Series Victory in Lahore

Pakistan successfully chased down a target of 326 to defeat Sri Lanka and win the ODI tri-series final in Lahore. According to the International Cricket Council (ICC), the victory provides vital momentum for the home side ahead of next year's ICC Men's Cricket World Cup.

Match Summary and Completed Result

  • Teams: Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka
  • Competition: ODI Tri-Series Final
  • Venue: Lahore
  • Result: Pakistan won by three wickets

Batting first after losing the toss, Sri Lanka posted a competitive total built on strong top-order performances. Openers Avishka Fernando and Kamindu Mendis established an 87-run partnership. While Fernando was dismissed for 38, Mendis went on to score 131 runs from 128 deliveries. Pavan Rathnayake added 77 runs from 65 balls to help lift Sri Lanka to 326.

Pakistan's Successful Run Chase

Pakistan's reply began poorly as they lost early wickets, with Maaz Sadaqat falling for 5 and Babar Azam dismissed for a duck. However, experienced left-hander Fakhar Zaman stabilized the innings, scoring 127 runs off 99 balls, including 11 fours and six sixes, marking his 12th ODI century.

Zaman was supported by Saad Baig, who contributed 74 runs from 75 deliveries to record his maiden ODI half-century. Although Pakistan slipped to 230 for five after 36.5 overs, middle-order contributions restored their momentum:

  • Arafat Minhas: 61 runs off 31 balls (3 fours, 4 sixes)
  • Hasan Nawaz: 37 runs off 45 balls
  • Shaheen Afridi: Captain hit the winning six to secure the three-wicket victory
